title: helmstudio studio manifest
description: One file per studio, at the root of the studio's own repository as helmstudio.yaml. The registry holds pointers to these, never copies. This schema is the whole extension surface: if supporting a studio needs a change to the daemon rather than a change here, the schema is wrong.

id.description: Stable slug. Used for paths, routes, token scope and the local override filename. Immutable once published.

name.description: Display name, lowercase as the studio names itself (e.g. 'h3 studio').

description.description: One line for the card. Clamped to a single line in the UI.

kinds.description: A list, not an enum: ltx and h3 are video AND audio.

hue.description: Identity colour, used only as a 3px stripe, a dot and a timeline clip — never as a button fill. Also injected as --helm-studio-accent. A studio without one is assigned from a generated ramp.

repo.description: git clone URL. Required unless local_path is set.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit. A registry entry always pins one.

local_path.description: Absolute path to an existing checkout. When set, cloning is skipped. Development only — a registry manifest never sets this.

tools.description: Probed before the first build step. Failing fast here beats failing inside make.

ram_gb.description: Minimum to install. A shortfall warns; it does not block.

disk_gb.description: Checkout, build output and weights together.

requires.description: os and arch mismatches block Install. Memory and disk shortfalls warn with the real number and let the user proceed.

peak_ram_gb.description: What the model actually occupies once loaded. Drives the switch dialog's arithmetic, so an estimate is better than nothing.

framework.description: How inference is implemented. 'native-kernel' means hand-written Metal/CUDA/C with no Python framework in the loop.

backends.description: Device backends this studio can actually use. The host check runs against THIS, not arch — a studio whose backends the host cannot provide is blocked, not warned.

language.description: The engine's own stack, shown as prose (e.g. 'c', 'go', 'python').

runtime.description: framework and backends are separate because PyTorch-on-cuda and PyTorch-on-mps are entirely different answers for a given machine.

python.description: Presence makes the daemon create a per-studio uv environment pinned to this version before any build step. Environments are never shared between studios.

capabilities.description: Least privilege, shown to the user before install as sentences rather than identifiers. No capabilities means no token is issued at all.

sdk.description: Majors pinned separately. The daemon injects matching bundle URLs at launch so a helmstudio update never jumps a studio across a major.

network.description: Hostnames this studio is expected to contact at build or run time. The smoke harness flags anything else.

index.description: Top-level JSON fields to build scoped expression indexes on at install time.

quota.description: Per-studio caps enforced on write. A studio in a retry loop must not be able to fill a disk.

name.description: Shown in the install checklist. Defaults to the command.

cwd.description: Relative to the studio root. Must not escape it.

shell.description: Declared now so a later Windows port does not invalidate every manifest ever written.

optional.description: A non-zero exit marks the step skipped rather than failing the install.

build.description: Executed in declared order, each in its own cwd. Non-zero exit stops the sequence; Retry resumes at the first step that has not succeeded.

name.description: The placeholder key: {models.<name>} in a process command.

dest.description: Directory name under the shared models root.

size_gb.description: For the disk pre-check, before any bytes move.

files.description: Allow-list of paths to fetch, and the presence check used when a directory is linked instead of downloaded.

selectable.description: One of a set the user picks between at launch, bound to {models.selected}. iris studio takes exactly one checkpoint per run.

processes.description: The supervised process group. Started in dependency order, each health-gated before its dependents; stopped in reverse.

run.description: Sugar for a single process with role 'main' and name 'studio'. Mutually exclusive with processes[].

profile.description: A reduced configuration — smaller model, fewer steps, shorter clip — so the smoke test exercises the real code path in under two minutes. Without one, nothing generative is testable in CI.

smoke.description: Path to the smoke test definition, relative to the studio root.

import.description: A one-time, idempotent importer run on first launch under helmstudio, adopting data the studio already has. Never moves or deletes the originals.

allOf.description: A studio is cloned or it is local, never neither.
processes[] and the run sugar are mutually exclusive.

name.description: Unique within the studio. Exposed to siblings as {ports.<name>}.

role.description: main owns the UI and the Launch button. oneshot runs to completion before dependents start.

prefer.description: Advisory. Used when free, otherwise the daemon assigns from its range.

fixed.description: Refuses to start when taken, naming the occupant. For a process that cannot accept a port flag.

port.description: Omit entirely for a process that listens on nothing.

tcp.description: A successful connect to the assigned port is enough.

exec.description: A command whose zero exit means healthy. For a worker with no endpoint.

timeout_s.description: The budget, shown to the user as elapsed against it. A studio that loads 20 GB before answering needs a large one; a thin wrapper needs a small one so a dead process is reported quickly.

health.description: Exactly one probe shape. A failed health check never restarts a main process — an eight-minute generation must survive a slow probe.

path.description: HTTP GET on the process's assigned port. Answers 200 with a JSON object: {"busy": boolean (required) — work in flight, "loaded": boolean — holds a model, "message": string, "progress": number 0..1}. Any other status, a body without a boolean busy, a progress outside 0..1, or no answer within 2 s reads as unknown, which is never shown as idle.

busy.description: Liveness is not occupancy. A studio may be running and holding nothing, or running and holding 21 GB. Without this the switch dialog is guessing. Asked only when a heavy launch would stop this studio; an answer never changes process or health state (docs/decisions.md M5 Q12).

depends_on.description: Names of sibling processes that must be healthy first. The validator rejects unknown names and cycles.

autostart.description: False lets a user start a worker on demand from the studio page.

restart.description: A main process is never auto-restarted. A sidecar with on-failure retries with backoff, at most three times in ten minutes, then the group fails.

heavy.description: Marks the process that holds the model. The one-heavy-group-at-a-time rule is evaluated on this member.

ui.description: Path the Open button targets. Meaningful on a main process.
